args.question: Would you like me to use the Environmental Condition Classification System (ECCS) to classify each site into environmental condition categories?

tool_trajectory.result: Yes, please use the Environmental Condition Classification System (ECCS) to classify each site into environmental condition categories based on the average ESI value.

args.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temp,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.zoneref,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.avg_temp + sa.avg_humidity + sa.avg_illumination) / 3) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM SiteAverages sa
),
SiteECCS AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        CASE 
            WHEN se.envhaz = 'Low' THEN 'Good'
            WHEN se.envhaz = 'Medium' THEN 'Fair'
            WHEN se.envhaz = 'High' THEN 'Poor'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS eccs_category
    FROM sites se
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temp AS average_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity AS average_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination AS average_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile AS suitability_quartile,
    se.eccs_category AS environmental_condition
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.zoneref
JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.zoneref
JOIN 
    SiteECCS se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref;
